title: The Voyage of Captain Popanilla
author: Disraeli, Benjamin, Earl of Beaconsfield
description: "The Voyage of Captain Popanilla" by Benjamin Disraeli is a satirical novel published in 1828.
longDescription: When Popanilla discovers books washed ashore on his idyllic island, he becomes obsessed with "progress" and development.

authorInfo.bio: Disraeli, Benjamin, Earl of Beaconsfield (1804–1881) wrote The Voyage of Captain Popanilla. Their work forms part of the historical literary record preserved in this edition. The linked reference offers further details about their life and bibliography.
